goal: Build a drawer-open station: Franka pulls open a kitchen-cabinet drawer (prismatic joint along Y axis, ~30cm travel). Validates the articulated-mechanism manipulation pattern needed for fixture-disassembly and inspection workflows.
thoughts: Drawer = parent cabinet body (static) + drawer face (rigid + prismatic-jointed). Joint axis along world Y (drawer pulls toward robot when its base is on +Y side). Joint upper limit = 0.30m travel.
Handle is a small cylinder/cube extruded from drawer face (z=center, x=center, y=front face). Robot grips handle, pulls in -Y direction.

setup_pick_place_controller doesn't natively support drawer-pull motion. This canonical uses a custom 6-waypoint trajectory: approach, grasp_handle, pull_back (joint extends), release. Initial implementation: target_source='spline' with hardcoded waypoints + manual gripper close; later: target_source='curobo' with constraint_phrase='maintain Y-pull while preserving handle grasp'.

Success criterion: drawer joint position >= 0.25m (within 5cm of full open) AND robot wrist within 5cm of nominal release pose. simulate_traversal_check is N/A (no cube delivery); custom validation via joint position read.
Asset: built from primitives (cube body + cube drawer + cylinder handle), no Nucleus dependency. Less faithful than Isaac Lab's Open-Drawer-Franka but unblocks the canonical.
code:
create_prim(prim_path="/World/DomeLight", prim_type="DomeLight")
set_attribute(prim_path="/World/DomeLight", attr_name="inputs:intensity", value=1000.0)
create_prim(prim_path="/World/Ground", prim_type="Cube", position=[0, 0, -0.5], scale=[20, 20, 1])
apply_api_schema(prim_path="/World/Ground", schema_name="PhysicsCollisionAPI")

# ── Physics: CPU dynamics for stable joint simulation ────────────────────────
set_physics_scene_config(config={"enable_gpu_dynamics": False, "broadphase_type": "MBP"})

# ── Robot table ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# Table top z = 0.375 * 2 = 0.75m. Franka base placed ON this surface at z=0.75.
create_prim(prim_path="/World/Table", prim_type="Cube", position=[0.0, 0.0, 0.375], scale=[0.7, 0.7, 0.375])
apply_api_schema(prim_path="/World/Table", schema_name="PhysicsCollisionAPI")

# ── Cabinet assembly ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# Cabinet top-center at x=0.70, z=0.95 (sits on table top). Body is static geometry.
# Cabinet body: 0.45m wide (X) x 0.30m deep (Y) x 0.40m tall (Z).
# scale values are HALF-extents in USD convention: scale=[0.225, 0.15, 0.20] -> actual 0.45 x 0.30 x 0.40m
create_prim(prim_path="/World/Cabinet", prim_type="Xform")
create_prim(prim_path="/World/Cabinet/Body", prim_type="Cube", position=[0.70, 0.0, 0.95], scale=[0.225, 0.15, 0.20])
apply_api_schema(prim_path="/World/Cabinet/Body", schema_name="PhysicsCollisionAPI")
# Body is NOT given RigidBodyAPI -> it is static (world-anchored) by default in Isaac Sim

# ── Drawer (rigid, prismatically jointed to cabinet body) ─────────────────────
# Drawer starts CLOSED at x=0.70 (flush with cabinet front face at x=0.70-0.225=0.475).
# Drawer geometry: 0.38m wide (X) x 0.28m deep (Y) x 0.18m tall (Z).
# Closed position: drawer front face flush with cabinet front -> drawer center x = 0.475 + 0.19 = 0.665
# We position drawer center at x=0.665, same y=0, same z=0.95 as cabinet center.
create_prim(prim_path="/World/Cabinet/Drawer", prim_type="Cube", position=[0.665, 0.0, 0.95], scale=[0.19, 0.14, 0.09])
apply_api_schema(prim_path="/World/Cabinet/Drawer", schema_name="PhysicsRigidBodyAPI")
apply_api_schema(prim_path="/World/Cabinet/Drawer", schema_name="PhysicsCollisionAPI")
set_attribute(prim_path="/World/Cabinet/Drawer", attr_name="physics:mass", value=1.5)

# ── Drawer handle ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# Small box handle protruding from the drawer FRONT face (robot-facing side).
# Drawer front face at x = 0.665 - 0.19 = 0.475. Handle protrudes further at x=0.445.
# Handle BAR 6cm out from the face (cuRobo hand-sphere clearance: a straight-
# down grasp 4cm from the tall cabinet face is res_None — the hand is ~6cm
# deep) + a thin STEM connecting bar to the drawer face, like a real handle.
# Local coords compensate parent scale [0.19, 0.14, 0.09]:
# bar world (0.415, 0, 0.95) he (0.02, 0.012, 0.012); stem world (0.455, 0, 0.95) he (0.02, 0.006, 0.006)
create_prim(prim_path="/World/Cabinet/Drawer/Handle", prim_type="Cube", position=[-1.31579, 0.0, 0.0], scale=[0.06316, 0.28571, 0.13333])
apply_api_schema(prim_path="/World/Cabinet/Drawer/Handle", schema_name="PhysicsCollisionAPI")
create_prim(prim_path="/World/Cabinet/Drawer/HandleStem", prim_type="Cube", position=[-1.10526, 0.0, 0.0], scale=[0.10526, 0.04286, 0.06667])
apply_api_schema(prim_path="/World/Cabinet/Drawer/HandleStem", schema_name="PhysicsCollisionAPI")

# ── Prismatic joint: cabinet body -> drawer, axis X (pull toward robot) ───────
# Joint axis along X. Lower limit = -0.30 (fully open = 30 cm pulled out toward robot).
# Upper limit = 0.0 (fully closed). Drawer starts at position 0 (closed).
create_physics_joint(
    joint_path="/World/Cabinet/DrawerJoint",
    joint_type="prismatic",
    body0="/World/Cabinet/Body",
    body1="/World/Cabinet/Drawer",
    axis="X",
    lower_limit=-0.30,
    upper_limit=0.0,
)

# ── Franka arm (ON table at z=0.75, facing cabinet) ──────────────────────────
# Robot base at z=0.75 (table top). Faces +X direction (cabinet is at x=0.70+).
# orientation [0, 0, 0, 1] = identity -> Franka default forward is +X.
# Franka base at x=0.0, drawer handle at x=0.435: reach distance = 0.435m, well within 0.85m.
robot_wizard(
    robot_name="franka",
    dest_path="/World/Franka",
    position=[0.12, 0.35, 0.75],
    orientation=[0, 0, 0, 1],
)

# ── Pick-place controller: grasp handle and pull in -X direction ──────────────
# Using spline target_source with handle as source; the robot grasps the handle
# and the joint physics drives drawer motion when robot pulls back.
# source_paths=[handle path] -> robot moves to handle, closes gripper, then
# executes pull waypoints in -X to open drawer.
setup_pick_place_controller(
    robot_path="/World/Franka",
    target_source="curobo",
    source_paths=["/World/Cabinet/Drawer/Handle"],
    destination_path="/World/Cabinet/Drawer/Handle",
    pick_target=[0.415, 0.0, 0.95],
    drop_target=[0.135, 0.0, 0.95],
    planning_obstacles=["/World/Table", "/World/Cabinet/Body"],
    grip_style="friction",
    task="pull",
    joint_path="/World/Cabinet/DrawerJoint",
)

verify_args.note: Articulated-mechanism diagnostic canonical — no cube delivery. Success criterion is /World/Cabinet/DrawerJoint position attribute reaching at least 0.25 m of pull (within 5 cm of full open at lowerLimit=-0.30 m, since axis=X with lower=-0.30 / upper=0.0). Measured via get_attribute on physics:lowerLimit / jointPosition.

extension_notes: First articulated-manipulation canonical. No cube delivery — success measured via PrismaticJoint position attribute. Currently spline controller with handle-as-source workaround; cuRobo + constraint_phrase upgrade is follow-on work.
failure_modes: PhysicsPrismaticJoint axis convention varies by Isaac Sim version; X may need to be 'Y' or {1,0,0} tuple
Spline controller doesn't know how to pull drawer — hardcoded waypoints would drag in absolute world space, but the handle moves with the drawer → motion plan diverges
Mass too low → drawer flies open from light contact; mass too high → robot wrist torque saturates
Sensor=handle path treats handle as movable cube — pick-place controller may try to LIFT handle vertically instead of pulling horizontally
verified_status: build-spec-2026-05-10; build OK, gate stable_fail (pick-place controller cannot drive PrismaticJoint; needs constraint-aware controller); function-gate diagnostic — success measured via DrawerJoint position attribute (pull >= 0.25 m of 0.30 m lowerLimit) rather than cube-in-bin delivery. Wave-2 self-ref redesign 2026-05-18.

migration_deferred.details: Requires kitchen-cabinet drawer USD from Nucleus (NVIDIA Isaac assets); not available locally
